top_signals.title: Copper Holds Losses Below $14,000 on US Midterm Risks to Stocks
top_signals.summary: Copper fell for a second day as stocks dropped, after early US midterm results pointed to the growing prospect of a Democratic sweep of Congress.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Nasdaq Futures Slide as Signs of Blue Wave Weigh on AI Complex
top_signals.summary: US equity index futures dropped Tuesday night on projections that Democrats would win control of the US House of Representatives, a potential blow to Republican mega donors like Elon Musk and his companies as regulatory risks grow for AI-linked stocks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: CZ calls for crypto security alliance as AI-driven attacks accelerate after Binance hack
top_signals.summary: In his first interview since the Binance hack, Changpeng Zhao says AI is accelerating cyberattacks and calls for industry security alliance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: South Korea’s ruling party formally proposes deferral of crypto income tax
top_signals.summary: The party leader stated that the country should first enact the Digital Asset Basic Act, a comprehensive legal framework for crypto.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
